answer.rationale: The scenario is covered servicing under the hazardous-energy-control standard and identifies hazards from unexpected startup and stored pneumatic energy. The employer must maintain an energy-control program; develop, document, and use energy-control procedures; train employees; isolate the machine from its energy source through energy-isolating devices; and relieve, disconnect, restrain, or otherwise render stored pneumatic energy safe after lockout/tagout devices are applied.
